name: LaserPecker LP1 Plus
tagline: LaserPecker LP1 Plus: pocket engraver step above LP1 Pro
tldr: LaserPecker LP1 Plus sits between LP1 Pro and LP2 in the pocket line: still ultra-compact, app-first, for jewelry-scale and travel engraving rather than sheet goods.

priceRange.note: Official LaserPecker US store, Oct 2026: $219 to $379 depending on bundle

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

pros: 0.6W (405 nm) on LaserPecker LP1 Plus: surface engraving on wood, leather and paper, not cutting
Open-frame: plan laser glasses, exhaust, and workspace rules from day one
Work area 100 × 100 mm: confirm your typical job sizes fit
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone

editorialDepth.advantages: LaserPecker LP1 Plus (0.6W) suits makers who personalize small gifts, tags and photos on the go. Pocket size and power-bank operation are the point.
editorialDepth.limitations: It does not cut: 0.6W is for surface marks only. Not for acrylic, bare metal without spray, or production work.
